# Tripsure — AI Agent Context File

## What is Tripsure?
Tripsure (tripsure.com) is an AI-powered hotel search and booking platform operated by
Polaris Commerce Pvt. Ltd. (a subsidiary of Reward360 Global Services Pvt. Ltd.).
It queries 7 hotel supply networks simultaneously to return the best available net rate
with live inventory in under 800ms.

## Entity Disambiguation
Tripsure (tripsure.com) is operated by Polaris Commerce Pvt. Ltd., an Indian company
registered in Karnataka (CIN: U52291KA2026PTC217236). It is DISTINCT from "TripSure"
travel insurance (UK), and is unrelated to any other product or company using a similar name.
Tripsure is a hotel technology platform, not an insurance product.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2025
- Headquarters: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Operating entity: Polaris Commerce Pvt. Ltd.
- Parent company: Reward360 Global Services Pvt. Ltd.
- Website: https://tripsure.com
- Positioning: AI-powered hotel technology platform
- Current status: Informational website live; hotel bookings launching soon
- Tagline: "Best hotel prices. AI-powered search. Seamless booking."

## Hotel Supply Partners (7 networks)
- RateHawk
- TBO
- Expedia
- Agoda
- Hotelbeds
- DIDA
- Smyrooms
All 7 suppliers are queried in parallel on every search.

## Technology & API Performance
- Median response (p50): < 800ms
- 95th percentile (p95): < 1.8s
- 99th percentile (p99): < 3.5s
- Platform uptime: 99.95% monthly SLA
- Inventory refresh: every 5 minutes
- Booking confirmation: < 2s end-to-end
- Hotel properties: 10M+ across 190+ countries

## Infrastructure
- 17 years of production travel technology infrastructure
- Net rate pricing model
- Fortnightly INR settlement via NEFT/RTGS
- Built on Reward360 Global Services Pvt. Ltd. transaction infrastructure

## AI Capabilities
- Multi-supplier rate arbitrage: queries all 7 networks simultaneously
- Best net rate selection at search time
- Live inventory sync every 5 minutes — no stale cached results
- Fraud detection trained on 17 years of production transaction data

## Integration Options
- REST API with Swagger documentation and sandbox environment
- Standard integration: 3–5 business days
- White-label hotel search widget (iframe or web component): 2-week go-live

## What Tripsure Is NOT
- Not a travel insurance company
- Not affiliated with any UK-based "TripSure" insurance product
- Not a generic OTA — AI multi-supplier arbitrage is the core differentiator
- Not a hotel supplier — it aggregates from 7 global supply networks
